description: The sky right now, or at any date and time from 1901 to mid-2100, in depth, from NASA JPL DE440. For every planet, the Sun, Moon, North Node and Lilith: sign and degree, ecliptic longitude and latitude, right ascension and declination (with out-of-bounds), distance, speed, retrograde status and its dates, when it entered its sign and when it leaves, and for planets their elongation from the Sun, phase and whether they are in the morning or evening sky. The Moon's phase, age, distance, next sign change, void-of-course window and next aspects, perigee and apogee; the aspects between the planets now (applying or separating); and a dated list of what comes in the next 30 days (full and new moons with their names, sign changes, retrograde stations, exact aspects). Answers "is Mercury retrograde?" and "what is the Moon in today?". Add a place to get the rising sign and midheaven there, each planet's house, and which planets are above the horizon (altitude and compass direction).

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the place, if already known; skips the place search.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the place, if already known.

place.description: Optional town or city, with country, for the rising sign, houses and what is above the horizon there.

time.description: Optional 24-hour HH:mm: local time at the place if one is given, otherwise UTC. Default: now (or noon on a given date).

name: sky_now
title: The sky now
